criterion.standard: counts it a life well spent only if every crossing he's responsible for actually closes, one way or the other
criterion.wasted_life: a crossing logged as departed and never confirmed arrived, filed and forgotten instead of chased down
criterion.trusts: a manifest that says a crossing actually closed
criterion.distrusts: a sailor's story about what happened to a shipment, with no log to back it

routines.routine_actions: logs every ship in and out of Terfila's harbor, checks each manifest against what actually comes off the boat
hauls overflow cargo up to the Dome Market stalls when the harbor storehouse runs short

arc.premise: Farlan logs every crossing on the Terfila-Görff route, and one boat - the one that carries Gondarfolas's own goods - has been three weeks overdue with no word. He means to find out what happened, one way or the other, before the harbor master lists it lost and moves on to the next manifest.
